upload.note: Initial upload attempt failed because COM5 was busy. Upload succeeded after the Lab page disconnected from the serial port.

post_upload_serial_ping.reason: COM5 was denied on a follow-up ping attempt, indicating another port handle was active again.
post_upload_serial_ping.next_action: Use the Lab page after reconnecting to COM5, select Use Smooth UNO Sketch, Send Ping, and verify PONG SmoothServoBenchTester in the serial log.

training_lesson: If a Studio page owns a hardware connection, MIM should manage or route the in-app Disconnect action before escalating to Dave. Dave should not be the manual fallback for controls that already exist in Studio.
